description: Plain text, no mode on: a word with a minus or a plus sign written on digits that have a comma or a period in them and are no number the number reader takes (a comma with fewer or more than three digits after it, two periods), beside the same sign on a number it does take; with a dollar sign after the sign; at the start and at the end of a sentence; and one such word in the europe mode, where the marks are the other way round. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.

entries.text: The lake froze at -4,5 last night.
The lake froze at -4.5 last night.
[:mode europe on] The lake froze at -4.5 last night.
